data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 proposes a reduction (SRC_005 reduces to SRC_002) but misidentifies what it is reducing: it frames the reduction as collapsing 'pruning-via-efficiency' into the suppression mechanism, yet the stated reduction endpoint is the lineage-dependency tax, not suppression itself. The argument conflates the tax (a cost) with the suppression mechanism (a process), so the reduction relation lacks a coherent mapping — it reduces one claim to a different claim than the one named as the reduction target.
